name: Speed burst
description: Your whole team skates 15% faster for 10 seconds.

name: Dead eye
description: Shots barely stray from their aim for 15 seconds.

name: Iron wall
description: Your goalie covers 30% more net for 12 seconds.

name: Cat reflexes
description: Your goalie reacts twice as fast for 12 seconds.

name: Second wind
description: The line on the ice is fully rested at once.

name: Fresh legs
description: The line on the bench is fully rested at once.

name: Adrenaline
description: Sprinting and skating cost almost no energy for 15 seconds.

name: Magnet hands
description: Very hard to check off the puck for 15 seconds.

name: Wrecking crew
description: Your checks land far more often for 15 seconds.

name: Smelling salts
description: Every skater, on the ice and on the bench, is fully rested at once.

name: Ghost passes
description: Your flat passes cannot be picked off for 15 seconds.

name: Afterburner
description: Much faster with the puck for 12 seconds, and faster still on a breakaway.

name: Sledgehammer
description: For 12 seconds every body check of yours that lands puts him on the ice.

name: Sticky glove
description: For 20 seconds your goalie holds on to much harder shots and gives smaller rebounds.

name: Spark
description: Your momentum meter fills at once: the team is on fire.
